purpose: Homepage design concept; not an implemented page
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one polished, high-fidelity DESKTOP HOMEPAGE DESIGN CONCEPT for the project “Facta, non verba”. This is a full webpage screenshot, flat and straight-on, not a laptop/phone mockup, not a poster, not a collage of screens. Landscape 4:3 composition, approximately 1600 × 1200, with crisp readable interface typography.

Project meaning: an open cooperation protocol for people and software agents to agree on real-world work, exchange signed evidence, and shape fair working terms through participation. A reference protocol, evidence-capture app, and simulator exist; do not imply a functioning payments marketplace. The brand means tangible actions with accountable records, care, and practical cooperation.

Input image: reference for the brand character only. Faithfully use the supplied faceless, cream-robed botanical character holding a reddish-brown book at viewer-left and a two-leaf sprout at viewer-right. Preserve its blank oval face, hand-drawn near-black outlines, restrained watercolor texture, cord belt, and muted palette. No facial features, sci-fi robots, coins, blockchain graphics, or religious ornaments. Render the character beautifully at large scale as the main hero illustration on the right, with a subtle soft sage circular field behind it and ample whitespace. Keep book and plant visible.

Art direction: a contemporary civic / independent publishing identity, elegant and quietly confident. Warm ivory background #F6F2E8, near-black forest ink #242C24, moss green #526A48, terracotta #A86043, muted golden details. Combine very large sophisticated editorial serif headlines with compact clean sans-serif UI. Fine hairline rules, generous spacing, restrained rectangular buttons with subtly softened corners. Avoid stock SaaS blue gradients, glassmorphism, heavy shadows, excessive card grids, and fake metrics. The organic character and precise layout should feel like a coherent visual system.

Page layout:
1. A slim ivory header with a small sprout symbol and lowercase serif wordmark “facta, non verba” on the left. Right navigation: “How it works”, “For operators”, “Protocol”, followed by a modest outlined “Explore the demo” button. Hairline below.
2. Expansive two-column hero. Left about 55%, right about 45%. Left eyebrow in small widely tracked sans-serif: “A PROTOCOL FOR COOPERATION”. Very large two-line headline, exactly:
“Facta,
non verba.”
Make the second line an elegant moss-green italic serif, the first near-black. Under it a small English line “Actions with a record.” Then a restrained three-line paragraph, exactly: “A protocol for people and agents to agree on work, share signed evidence, and shape fair terms together.”
Two buttons below: dark forest-green filled “Explore the demo ↗”, and understated text action “Read the protocol →”.
The right hero contains the reference botanical character. Overlay its lower-left area with one small impeccably typeset ivory evidence card with a fine border, keeping the head, book and plant visible. Card text:
“EXAMPLE WORKFLOW”
“Restore the community garden”
“Agreed scope · Signed evidence”
“Outcome ready for review”
Use one small terracotta status dot and a subtle document/check icon. No fake monetary amounts, no invented user counts.
3. Below the hero, a thin rule and a broad horizontal explanation section. Left small heading “From intention to outcome.” Four steps across the remaining width, with tiny line icons and generous space:
“01  Request” / “Define the work.”
“02  Agree” / “Set the terms.”
“03  Capture” / “Attach signed evidence.”
“04  Review” / “Assess the outcome.”
4. Along the bottom edge show the beginning of the next section, separated by a hairline: a small uppercase kicker “BUILT THROUGH PARTICIPATION” and medium serif sentence “The people doing the work help shape its terms.” This should feel like a real page continuing below the fold.

Keep the design airy, intentional and sophisticated. Strong clear hierarchy, typography aligned to a consistent grid, illustration and text balanced. Every visible word should be accurately spelled. No developer jargon, code snippets, wallets, sign-up forms, speculative transaction screens, fake testimonials, promotional badges, or stock photography. One cohesive homepage concept with the branded character as the hero.
refinementPrompt: Edit target: the supplied homepage concept image. This is a WEBSITE SCREENSHOT, NOT a transparent branding asset. Correct the entire background and compositing. Produce a FULLY OPAQUE rectangular webpage image, with an uninterrupted solid warm ivory #F6F2E8 background across the entire canvas, behind every word, logo, navigation item, illustration and section. ALL pixels must be opaque (alpha255 everywhere), including all four corners; absolutely NO transparency. Remove any colored fringe artifacts. Preserve the editorial layout, typography, all wording, forest-green accents, character illustration, sage circular field, example workflow card and bottom process strip. Keep the text dark and clearly readable on the opaque ivory page. Preserve exact large headline 'Facta, non verba.' and all existing navigation and explanatory copy. Regenerate only as needed to make an impeccably clean and readable finished homepage screenshot. Do not remove the background after rendering. Do not provide a cutout, mask, alpha matte, or checkerboard. The complete ivory page background is an essential part of the requested final image.
